_instructions: After ANY edit to this file, run: bash ~/.hermes/dashboard/publish.sh

title: Hermes Wiki
summary: Local Obsidian knowledge system where reviewed information accumulates instead of disappearing in chat history.
details: Raw/ preserves source material without edits
Sources/ stores reviewed summaries
Topic pages hold accumulated knowledge
SCHEMA.md defines ingest, query, and lint rules

title: Hermes memory index
summary: Small always-loaded memory indexes point to focused detail files that are opened only when relevant.
details: User preferences and stable facts stay compact
Detailed notes live in ~/.hermes/memory/
Temporary task progress stays out of permanent memory

title: Content knowledge pipeline
summary: Turns videos, articles, and papers into reviewed source notes, reusable takeaways, and optional blog material.
details: Original source is inspected first
Claims remain attributed
Dashboard publication requires an explicit request
The Hermes Wiki is the default local destination

title: YouTube transcript extraction
summary: Fetches captions and timestamps for video summaries, including Hebrew caption fallback.
details: Uses youtube-transcript-api first
Uses yt-dlp caption extraction when the standard transcript endpoint fails
Auto-generated captions are not treated as exact quotations

title: Dashboard publish and validation loop
summary: One command validates the dashboard, refreshes its data, validates again, commits, and publishes.
details: publish.sh is the only canonical publish path
validate_dashboard.py catches missing links and data wiring
Dashboard changes are not reported complete until the live result is verified

title: Custom skills library
summary: Reusable procedures record how Elli's recurring work should be performed and verified.
details: Custom skills are marked in their YAML frontmatter
They appear automatically on the dashboard Skills page
Skills are updated when a workflow or command changes

title: Accessibility experience widget
summary: Dashboard control panel for contrast, font, text size, motion, focus, spacing, reading guide, cursor, and color-vision modes.
details: Preferences persist in the browser
Designed for the person using the page
Kept separate from accessibility testing tools

title: Accessibility audit panel
summary: Visual inspection tools for headings, landmarks, alternative text, labels, hidden content, focus, tab order, ARIA, forms, and contrast.
details: Designed for QA and accessibility review
Runs directly in the dashboard page
Planned as a reusable A11y Toolkit module

title: Discord Hermes gateway
summary: Runs Hermes as a macOS background service so Discord messages reach the same local agent and tools.
details: Managed by launchd
Restarts automatically after a crash
Discord remains the main command surface

title: Gateway health service
summary: Small local service exposes gateway status and recovery controls without putting them into the public static dashboard.
details: Runs as a macOS LaunchAgent
Keeps local health controls separate from public data
Supports status and restart endpoints

title: Model routing and fallbacks
summary: Codex is the default; supporting tasks and failures use configured cloud or local fallback paths without switching to Anthropic unless requested.
details: Primary model and provider are explicit
Fallback order is documented
Privacy, price, and reliability are considered before routing changes

title: Calm Compass dashboard replacement
summary: Private AI-first dashboard replacement with one recommended next action and three stable rings: Today, Your world, and Setup.
details: The old public dashboard remains live until explicit cutover approval
The replacement uses Google authentication and server-only private snapshots
Desktop and Android map layouts are implemented
Final accessibility, deployment, and acceptance work remains
